content: Implement the first M0130 W0132 device-memory slice: add a generation-bound software staging allocator and timeline admission model behind the Vulkan backend, exercise alignment, overlap, lifetime, generation, and completion rejection, and keep physical Vulkan allocation and driver qualification explicitly open.

Content revision 67eaf28 adds StagingLedger and TimelineGate to the Vulkan runtime. The ledger derives a staging budget from the capability profile, enforces power-of-two alignment, first-fit non-overlap, release/reuse, and generation checks; the timeline enforces monotonic submission/completion and stale/future rejection.

Vulkan configure/build and full CTest passed 84/84, including the new memory model test; Agent records and git diff checks passed. This is a host-independent model and does not claim VkDeviceMemory allocation, direct import, or physical driver qualification.
